top_signals.title: Bank of England announces the four animals that will feature on our next series of banknotes
top_signals.summary: The Atlantic puffin, barn owl, buff-tailed bumblebee and European hedgehog will represent UK wildlife and feature as the central images on our next series of banknotes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Minutes of the SONIA Stakeholder Advisory Group - 25 September 2026
top_signals.summary: The SONIA Stakeholder Advisory Group supports the Bank’s administration of SONIA by providing advice and technical input to the Bank and the SONIA Oversight Committee

top_signals.title: Uniswap’s aggregator hooks go live on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain
top_signals.summary: Uniswap Labs has launched aggregator hooks, allowing Uniswap v4 to route trades through liquidity held on external platforms.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
